notes.title: v1.4 Nymphs
notes.content:
Added Nymph enemy who will lure you towards her
 Added embers on start screen
 Added sound for pick up gem
 Added capture icon to resources that have been claimed

 Efficiencies for player
 Moved all input out of _Process function and into _Input
 Changed refresh rate to 90fps for steam deck
 Removed fog of war in minimap
 Upgraded godot to version 4.4

notes.title: V0.32 Small Fixes and Decorations
notes.content:
Fixed bug with enemies staying after death
 Music now plays continuously when switching scenes
 Added new music assets
 Implemented decorations
 Decorations can be turned off in settings
 Added option to turn player ghost on or off
 Player animation now plays backwards when walking backwards
 Added Fire Bats that will light you on fire!
 Added fire material for weapons
